When I reported the behavior, I was told there was nothing they could do.

There’s a difference between competitive gameplay and enabling harassment. Without stronger protections or meaningful developer support, it’s hard to feel safe investing time or money into this game.

I cannot recommend it in its current state.

title: Unplayable, horrible software quality
content:
I have played this game for years, have a high level powerful castle and am part of a top battlefield team in the Evony competitions of BoC, BoG and Civ. 

This game has always been very low quality with major bugs and failings. 

Lately it has become so bad that I had to sit and watch during a battlefield competition because their game erased all those settings you need to use in competition WHILE WE WERE IN THE MIDDLE OF COMPETING. 

As always, their customer service folks do nothing but ask for screenshots, but they already know their customer service interface is broken and won’t allow screenshots to be uploaded. 

Many long time players have left the game due to the horrible software quality, constant bugs and terrible performance. 

In addition they have automated things like reporting a player to get them muted, which has resulted in certain players constantly using their automated reporting to mute anyone they want to, thus ruining the social side of the game as well. 

Lastly, be prepared to spend a minimum of $1,000 USD per month to even have a good enough castle to be the least powerful on a battlefield team. 

There are many better, less expensive and much higher quality games out there.
